$comment: Input for scripts/car-model/segment-stl.py (parts) and stl-to-glb.mjs (everything else). Single-shell 1:33 print model (no kit assembly): raw x = width, raw y = length (nose at -y), raw z = up -> axes below is a proper rotation (a swap alone mirrors the mesh and inverts every normal). Scale from the wheelbase (82.0 mm between the contact patches = 2.722 m), offset from the mid-point between the axles and the body's centre line (raw x 119.3). Wheels + tyres are modelled in: cut out (`wheels`), the game draws its own. Ride: the mesh is a lowered street car (floor 7 cm) - offset y lifts the whole body (now -0.5 cm: the 7 cm lift was taken back, the user wanted the wheels low in the arches) vs the tyre-bottom pose (floor 0.142 m; 4 cm for the test map's crests, 3 more so the wheels sit lower in the arches, hubs stay at 0.345: rally stance; the autopilot beached on the test map's crests at 7 cm). Every y in `parts` / `wheels` below is in that raised model space.

wheels.$comment: the modelled wheels are removed by the `wheel cut` region picks in `parts` (an exact circular clip, no saw teeth) - nothing left for the radius cut; centres kept for the hub rule / arch options

liner.$comment: the cut-out leaves the arch see-through (the tyre was unioned with the liner - removing it left tyre-shaped holes in the well): a dark cup from |x| 0.45 out to 0.9, r 0.40 just inside the arch opening (r ~0.415 at the top), ends 0.3 rad below the hub (kept like this: a longer cup / wider outerX read as extended fenders on this non-GTR body). Its inner wall (hidden behind the tyre) is closed down to floorY 0.145 so the well is not an open window into the hollow body from underneath

wheelRim.$comment: Input for stl-wheel-extract.py: the model's own 8-spoke rim (front-left wheel) -> wheel GLB (`wheelModel`). Measured in radial sections: tyre r 0.215 - 0.345 (tread blocks 0.36), |x| 0.645 - 0.96; its inner wall at r 0.215 doubles as the rim barrel (jagged, fused into the tyre) -> replaced by the `lathe` lip + barrel; spokes + hub |x| 0.83 - 0.94 inside r 0.232, brake disc / caliper behind |x| 0.83 (dropped: the game draws its own). The model's wheels have NEGATIVE CAMBER (tuning stance): `axis` = the outer sidewall's plane normal (x = 0.9616 - 0.0757 dy - 0.002 dz, 4.3 deg, no toe, residual 9 mm); after removing it the hub bore, tyre tread and lip circles agree within 2 mm on `hub` (z 1.361, y 0.344 at depth x 0.80). The spoke pattern is NOT symmetric - centring on its 45 deg self-overlap (y 0.323) put the bore 2.7 cm off the axle (wheel debugger, car viewer `wheels=1`)

chartBoxes.$comment: rear bumper's side, from the arch to the corner (|x| > 0.6, z -2.1 .. -1.65, y 0.12 - 0.7): its top ledge (y 0.54 - 0.61) was on the top chart (crest-row cells: a blue band with a white streak across the checkers), a strip on the rear chart and the groove undersides on the bottom chart (light / dark lines through the red row, user view 2026-10-04) -> side chart, which holds the checker rows. Before the rear boxes; it reaches z -2.25 so the side / rear switch on the corner falls INSIDE the last side column (k = 6, z <= -2.08, the same colours as the rear's outer column) - ending at -2.1 put the switch on column k = 5 and the chart tint showed rear faces spiking into it (teeth, next user view)

rear bumper ledges (up-facing, y 0.3 - 0.68, behind z -2.0) were on the top chart, whose cells there are the boot lid's checker rows (blue at |x| 0.40 - 0.62, white elsewhere): a blue strip with white teeth along the bumper top across the red / blue rows (user view 2026-10-04) -> rear chart, which holds the row colour at the ledge's height

same bumper, inner part (|x| < 0.6, no side faces): the lips' undersides were on the bottom chart (dark undercoat lines under the ledges) and the plate-recess walls on the side charts -> rear chart too

rear bumper corner behind z -2.25 (|x| > 0.6): groove undersides were on the bottom chart (dark lines) -> rear chart; side-facing faces here land on the rear's outer column, which repeats the side's last column (k = 6, z <= -2.08), so the colours agree

number plate recess on the boot lid (|x| < 0.55, y 0.66 - 0.92, z -2.5 .. -2.15): its side walls were on the side charts (blue checker texels: a blue triangle in the recess's top corners) and its top lip on the bottom chart (dark), user view 2026-10-04 -> rear chart (white there)

lower door + sill between the arches: the up-facing ledges of the side mouldings / skirt landed on the top chart (white there) and showed as white streaks in the blue behind the side split (user view 2026-10-04) -> side chart of their own side, where the diagonal split applies

door side between the arches, y 0.2 - 0.84 (below the belt at 0.86): the shoulder crease's up-facing ledge (y 0.72 - 0.84) was on the top chart (a white line through the blue) and the mouldings' undersides on the bottom chart (dark undercoat lines on the white door) -> every face here to the side chart
door shut-line walls (facing along the car) between the arches landed on the end charts (white there): a white line down the door's rear gap in the blue -> side chart

B / C pillar round the rear quarter window: the frame steps facing along the car (z -1.34 .. -0.57, y 0.98 - 1.31) were on the end charts (white) - white dashes down the B pillar in the blue, a white sliver at the window's rear corner (user view 2026-10-04) -> side chart. Stops at z -1.35, in front of the tail checkers (z < -1.42)

parts.$comment: 12 deg crease: at 25 deg the glass panes, roof, doors and bonnet were one skin (the panel gaps are engraved grooves ~1 cm wide); at 12 deg every pane / panel is its own segment. The tail lamps are flush with the body (groove outline only) -> `region` outlines traced off the crease renders (rear view x 0.465 -> corner, y 0.665 -> 0.85 boot-lid gap; side: curved front edge z -2.075 at the bottom to -2.16 at the top).

picks.name: wheel cut (front): the modelled tyre + rim + hub carrier / disc / inner rim (|x| > 0.45: everything of the old wheel assembly, so the game's wheel + suspension have room), clipped exactly along a circle (r 0.372: tread blocks reach 0.36, the arch lip starts at ~0.375) - the converter drops this material (parts.drop); the game draws its own wheels

wheel cut (rear): the modelled tyre + rim + hub carrier / disc / inner rim (|x| > 0.45: everything of the old wheel assembly, so the game's wheel + suspension have room), clipped exactly along a circle (r 0.372: tread blocks reach 0.36, the arch lip starts at ~0.375) - the converter drops this material (parts.drop); the game draws its own wheels
window surrounds: every small segment touching a pane (frame strips, the engraved gap, belt moulding) - the big door / roof skins are over maxArea

window surround: rear quarter window + B pillar = the black plastic frame of the real car (user 2026-10-04, reference photo of a silver E46 coupe): the recessed band round the quarter glass, traced on a side-view depth map of the mesh (outermost |x| per 2.5 mm; walking out from the glass until the surface steps back up 5 mm: ~5.5 cm along the top up to the drip rail, out to z -1.30 at the rear corner where a 2 cm step ends it, 2 - 3 cm along the belt) plus the flat B-pillar panel (|x| 0.718) between the quarter glass and the door glass rear edge, belt to roof. Replaced the pane outline grown 2 cm, which left the recess and the B pillar livery-coloured
window surround: door window (pane outline from the glass segments, grown 2 cm; first pick wins so the glass stays glass)

window surround: rear window from above (outline of the glass, grown 1 cm - thin border; with 2 cm + a side-view ring the black spilled onto the C pillars and the boot lid like the windscreen did, user 2026-10-04)

window surround: windscreen from above (outline of the glass, grown 1 cm: a thin black border only - at 2 cm, together with a side-view ring that took the whole A pillars, the black read as the windscreen spilling onto the pillars and the bonnet corners, user 2026-10-04)

headlights - lamp (projector bowls): the engraved lamp outline traced on a front-view relief map of the mesh (2000 px/m, groove centre lines): top edge y 0.666 sweeping down to the inner tip at (0.376, 0.558) by the kidney, bottom y 0.545 with a hump to 0.56 under the inner bowl; ends at the amber divider |x| 0.74 (a groove at 0.73 - 0.75). `any`: also takes what earlier segment picks labelled; `facing` -0.5: the lamp wraps round the corner, sideways faces count, only the shell's inside (facing back) does not; depth from z 1.75 (12 hidden faces of an inner wall at z 1.6 - 1.7 behind the outer bowl would stretch the lamp UVs; only the amber below reaches back to z 1.6); depth from z 1.75 (12 hidden faces of an inner wall at z 1.6 - 1.7 behind the outer bowl would stretch the lamp UVs; only the amber below reaches back to z 1.6)

headlights - amber indicator: the lamp outline's outer end (|x| 0.74 -> the rounded end at 0.84), same relief map; own glowing part instead of a texture block (the old wrap texture drew it with a zig-zag edge)

bumper side intakes (recess round the fog lamps): exact outline of the recess opening, read row by row off a front-view depth map of the raw mesh (surface more than 6 mm behind the bumper face: slanted inner tip from |x| 0.467, top y 0.333, rounded outer end round the lamp to |x| 0.79, bottom y 0.23), grown 3 mm so the recess walls are included. Replaced an `inside` box that only took the recess segments on the car's right - on the left they are merged into a segment that pokes out of the box, so that recess stayed body colour (user 2026-10-04)

bonnet vent slats (the heat-out lines in the recess behind the dome): an exact rounded-rectangle outline cut, z 1.012 - 1.14 (the slats span z 1.02 - 1.13), x -0.338 .. 0.322 (traced at 1800 px/m) - a box pick took whole big skin triangles by their centre and left a ragged black patch

wiper arms + blades + the cowl lip they rest on: one band along the windscreen base (x -0.6 .. 0.56, from the glass edge 6 - 8 cm forward - wider on the left where the arm is parked forward), exact outline cut - the two wipers are parked differently and their crease segments interleave, so a segment pick came out ragged (and took the cowl panel)

mirror housings + stalks black (user 2026-10-04: not livery-coloured): front-view outline round the mirror + stalk (|x| 0.86 - 1.04, y 0.87 - 1.08, z 0.29 - 0.60) that follows the door skin narrowing with height (max |x| 0.81 at y 0.875, 0.79 at 0.9, 0.755 at 0.95, 0.74 at 1.0 - a single |x| > 0.858 box left the stalk root white); after the mirror glass pick so the glass stays glass
tail lamps - side (wraps the corner, curved front edge)
underbody (floor, driveshaft, exhaust, arms - seen from below / through the arches)

axles: driveshaft, arms, diff (|x| < 0.45 only - segment picks run BEFORE region cuts, so anything of the old wheel taken here would survive the wheel-cut circle; the hub carriers / discs / rims at |x| > 0.45 are left for the circle)

hub.$comment: facing -0.5 (not -0.25): the flares' rolled lips are big irregular triangles whose normals lean towards the hub a little - at -0.25 the border between dark lip and body ran through them as a saw-tooth crown over each arch; now only faces pointing clearly at the hub (liner, lip underside) are dark. radius 0.46: the liner is within that, the flare's outer skin further out

flatten.$comment: the print model domes the headlight glass over each bowl by up to 1 cm (user: the cover should be one big semi-flat glass, the bulges made the lamps behind look bad) -> one smooth cover fitted through the lamp outline. tiltDeg 10: the opening leans back 22 deg (top edge 5.5 cm behind the bottom over 12 cm) and the lamp read as aimed upwards from the front (user) - the cover now stands 12 deg more upright about its mid-height (upper half up to ~1.3 cm forward, lower half back), the shift ramped in over 2.5 cm from the outline so it rolls into the fixed border

fills.$comment: windscreen plane continued under the wipers: the glass stops at z ~0.84 (y 1.0 - 1.01) while the wiper bars (z 0.84 - 0.89) hover over empty space down to the cowl trough (z 0.91, y 0.955) - looked cut out. Plane fitted to the glass (slope -0.617 dy/dz), 2 mm below it, from z 0.838 (hidden overlap) to 0.885 (the cowl trough dips below the plane further forward - a longer fill would float over it; the black wiper band covers the rest), |x| < 0.5
